description: This file defines a class named GroupByApiRootConvention that implements the IControllerModelConvention interface to assign group names to API controllers based on their route templates, facilitating API versioning and grouping in ASP.NET Core projects.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: Implements IControllerModelConvention to configure API controller routing conventions based on route attribute templates.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Configures the controller's API explorer group name based on the route attribute template, parsing the API version from the route URL.
